scenes.text: What if the first pass of your marking backlog arrived already organized?
Marking backlogs drain time, consistency, and useful feedback quality.
HOMS Marking Relief Pack routes the work through a controlled pipeline instead of pretending AI can decide everything.
Draft feedback, annotated files where possible, rubric documents, marks CSV, and lecturer review summary.
Educator approves final marks and feedback. AI never becomes the final assessor.
Send one fake or non-sensitive batch to prove the workflow.
